newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Air Zimbabwe pilots end pay strike, agree to talk.
newsitem.headline: Air Zimbabwe pilots end pay strike, agree to talk.

text.p: Pilots and engineers at state-owned Air Zimbabwe returned to work on Saturday after a week-long strike for higher pay, officials said.
David Zamchiya, chairman of Air Zimbabwe Corporation, told reporters the strikers had resumed their duties after agreeing with his board to discuss demands and to reach a solution by April 4.
"That's is what we agreed and they have all gone back to work this afternoon," he said of the about 70 pilots and engineers.

The corporation was forced to hire four aircrafts and crew from other airliners to service the southern African country's domestic flights, which industry officials said helped reduce the impact of the strike Zimbabwe's vital tourism sector.
